thesis: The page is a topographic map: each section sits on its own contour band with an elevation label, and scrolling climbs the mountain from river-level repairs to ridge-top additions.

signature.name: Contour bands with elevation tags
signature.summary: Horizontal rust contour lines divide sections; each carries an elevation tag in mono type. Content organizes by altitude: river (water repair), mid-slope (porches/kitchens), steep (ADUs/retaining), ridge (service area). Elevation counter climbs on scroll.

motion.intro: SVG contour lines draw outward from city centre (stroke-dashoffset, 900ms); town names fade in at 600ms stagger; headline line-mask reveal 70ms stagger. Skippable by click. Reduced motion: final state immediate.
stories: elevation-counter-climb: corner counter counts up as scroll passes contour bands; contour lines shift at 0.3x parallax
plan-to-build-wipe: line drawing of hillside foundation wipes to photo via --sw-p clip-path in story section
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left (scaleX 0→1, origin left, 200ms ease-out) on all interactive elements
